evidenceBoundary: This registry has two disjoint append-only sections. controlReviews records only the allowlisted, non-authorizing PC-001 exact-candidate control implementation review; it can approve normal merge/reconciliation but can never make a task Ready or executionAllowed. Its candidate must be the sole child of the exact accepted Gate A merge, remain an ancestor, and contain no review record. Repository-wide history derives the first later canonical publication and rejects deletion, rewrite, or any current or historical PC-001 taskApproval even when the current controlReviews section is empty. One canonical reviewContextSha256 binds every non-seat field, and each of five role-bound seats binds that context with its own attestationDigest. Candidate and first-publication raw manifest, reviewer-registry, workbook, and complete task-file snapshots; current-HEAD and worktree bindings for the exact 14 stable workflow/tool controls; an exact closed 13-path mutable snapshot partition covering the reviewer registry, owner-action state, task-readiness state, task-state, and nine governed Markdown documents; the registry-only first-publication delta; contributor roles from the bound historical reviewer registry; exact verification counts; and the closed permitted claim are independently validated. Later unrelated descendant paths, mutable roadmap/workbook projections, evidence, and the exact 13 mutable snapshots do not rewrite this historical review. taskApprovals records at most one execution-permitting task-candidate review per task. Planning approval, generation, roadmap status, CI, issue closure, or a controlReview does not create a task approval. Each taskApproval binds an earlier single-parent candidate, its complete non-excluded Git diff by raw-byte SHA-256, purpose, mode and type, its six artifacts and task contract, and the five context-bound seats. It never embeds the commit that contains the record itself and may not be replaced after first publication. Only the closed publication/projection path set may differ at a descendant, and a later generated projection plus guarded exact-main callback is still required before execution.
